6. What Likely Would Have Gone Wrong Without Preparation
blocks.text: 6. What Likely Would Have Gone Wrong Without Preparation

blocks.content: A few real risks that this specific preparation helped avoid. Not recognizing which principle a given question was actually testing, leading to a technically fine but poorly targeted answer. A single story stretched awkwardly to cover every different question, rather than a genuine, distinct bank ready for different principles.
And being genuinely caught off guard by the real depth of the follow up questioning, having only prepared a single, surface level version of each story rather than a genuinely understood one.
